effect_description_eng: ＜Blocker＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Your opponent's ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects don't affect 1 of your Digimon until their turn ends. Then, if it's their turn, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of their Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon suspend, this Digimon may unsuspend.
